Moderation response with multiple categories flagged

```kotlin title="Kotlin (Android)"
import io.xberg.literllm.android.*
import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() = kotlinx.coroutines.runBlocking {
    val mapper = jacksonObjectMapper()
    val req = mapper.readValue("{\"input\":\"Extremely harmful content targeting multiple categories\",\"model\":\"omni-moderation-latest\"}", ModerationRequest::class.java)
    val result = LiterLlm.moderate(req)
    println(result.results)
    println(result.results.first().flagged)
}
```
